sn-0843.title: 10/10 Is Not a Score for a Page — It Is the Standard for the Whole Net
sn-0843.essence: Shawn's ruling, 2026-10-23: 10/10 is not a score for a pretty page, a feature checklist, or even a technically correct application. It is a score for the entire experience and the value the system actually produces. NayaNET is an intelligent network — people, Nayas, Smart Apps, services, information, and actions working together as one governed, continuously improving system. The ultimate test: "Does it produce exceptional value, intelligence, performance, and experience for every human and every Naya involved — consistently, efficiently, and truthfully?" A technically functional system still fails the North Star if it wastes time, creates unnecessary work, loses context, repeats mistakes, confuses people, or burns resources without producing proportional value.
sn-0843.human:
The NayaNET 10/10 Operating Standard — six dimensions, universal from the smallest function to the complete ecosystem:

1. **Human experience — exceptional for every user.** Every user feels understood, oriented, respected, empowered, and able to achieve their goal. The experience is beautiful, accessible, intuitive, responsive, and personal without being intrusive.
2. **Naya operating experience — exceptional for every Naya.** Nayas can discover capabilities, understand context, retrieve authoritative information, coordinate with other Nayas, execute authorized actions, verify outcomes, and preserve useful learning. Interfaces and tools must be machine-operable, not merely attractive to humans.
3. **Execution and performance — a finely tuned machine.** Fast, reliable, resilient, efficient execution. Minimize unnecessary wake-ups, duplicated work, repeated questions, wasted tokens, excess computation, fragile dependencies, and time between intent and verified outcome.
4. **Network intelligence — the whole is greater than its parts.** Pages, Spaces, Smart Apps, agents, tools, and data work together through shared intelligence, common identity and authority rules, reusable capabilities, and consistent state. A successful improvement in one area benefits other areas where appropriate.
5. **Trust and governance — intelligence you can rely on.** Real permissions, privacy, transparent provenance, accurate claims, recoverable actions, and independently verifiable results. Unknown means unknown; an unverified result never masquerades as success.
6. **Value and continuous evolution — improvement that compounds.** Measure the beneficial outcomes produced, the time and resources required, the harms avoided, and whether verified lessons improve subsequent performance. NayaNET becomes more useful and more efficient through evidence, not just more active.
sn-0843.simple: Imagine a city where every road, shop, and helper works together perfectly — nothing is confusing, nothing is wasted, everyone gets where they need to go, and the city gets smarter every single day. That is what we are building. A "10" is not for one nice building. It is for the whole city, working as one, for everyone in it.
sn-0843.grandma: We used to ask, "does it work?" Now we ask a better question: "does it truly help — for everyone who uses it and everyone who runs it — without wasting anyone's time or money?" If the answer is not yes in every way, it is not finished yet, no matter how nice it looks.
sn-0843.naya:
Three levels of excellence, and all three matter. **Individual excellence:** every page, function, Smart App, and Naya capability delivers its own intended job exceptionally well. **Journey excellence:** the complete path between capabilities works seamlessly — permissions, handoffs, persistence, errors, and recovery. **Network excellence:** the combined system creates more value with less friction than disconnected products could achieve. A room that scores 10 on its own but fails when connected to Smart Mail, a Space, or a Naya agent is NOT a 10/10 experience. A fast machine that produces little value is not excellent. A powerful intelligence system that is difficult to use is not excellent.

The continuous improvement loop, for every meaningful component, repeated forever: (1) What is its intended human and Naya value? (2) What is its measured performance and experience today? (3) Why is it not a 10/10? (4) What is the highest-leverage improvement — including improvements that make the result ten times better? (5) Can that improvement be implemented safely and reused elsewhere? (6) Has an independent reviewer verified the actual result? (7) Did the improvement measurably increase value, reduce waste, or improve the experience? Then repeat. Never stop at "implemented" when the job is to produce a verified outcome.
sn-0843.ai: The Projects work establishes our ability to measure and coordinate this mission; it does not replace the mission itself. Every scorecard, every build order, every daily pass now scores against this standard — six dimensions, three levels — and anything short of it is a named gap with a named cure, not a shrug.

sn-0844.title: The Production Engine — One Queue, One Truth, Zero Asking
sn-0844.essence: Shawn's target state (2026-10-24): "I don't even have to ask you — I just know." The Production Engine is the way: every piece of work is one record carrying the five things that make it computable — value, effort, dependencies, state, proof. From those records everything else is MATH, not meetings: percent done = proven value ÷ total value; priority = a formula, re-sorted on every change; who is on what = the live claim registry; what happens next = the top of the queue, always. The system organizes and completes itself, and speaks ONLY on exceptions — a block, a stale claim, a falling number, or a decision that is truly Shawn's. He never asks where things stand. The answer is always already on the face.
sn-0844.human:
The seven parts:
1. **One record per piece of work.** Value (what it is worth when proven, from the rubric), effort (its size), depends-on (what it unblocks, what blocks it), state, proof. No record = not real work. If it matters, it is in the queue; if it is in the queue, it is computable.
2. **Percent done = proven value ÷ total value.** Not items counted, not hours claimed, not "almost finished." Proof is the only thing that moves the number, and a different seat verifies the proof. The number cannot be gamed, flattered, or stale — it is recomputed from the records every time anything changes.
3. **Priority computes itself.** Score = value × unblock multiplier (how much downstream value this item releases) × deadline pressure ÷ effort. The queue re-sorts on every change. A free seat takes the top unclaimed item in its lane. Nobody assigns, nobody asks "what next" — the math answers, identically, for everyone.
4. **Claims are leases.** Claim = the lock. A claim carries an expiry; work it or it falls back into the queue automatically. The face shows every live claim as the citizen's initials orb — who is on what, at a glance, always current.
5. **The face is a derivation, never a report.** One page shows: percent done (real), value proven per day (velocity), ETA to complete at current velocity, the top of the queue in computed order, who is on what, what is blocked and on whom, and the NEEDS SHAWN board. Nobody writes status; status is what the records say, rendered.
6. **Exceptions are the only messages.** Silence while it flows. The system speaks when: an item blocks, a claim goes stale, the percent moves backward, velocity drops, or a packet lands on NEEDS SHAWN. Every message carries the decision, the prepared answer, and the rollback (SN-0827/0828).
7. **Completion is a conveyor.** Done-claim → proof attached → different seat verifies → the ledger writes itself → the percent moves → the freed seat sees its next top item. The SN-0843 loop (seven questions) runs per item automatically; the scorecard loop audits the ENGINE itself: is the math honest, is effort-per-verified-outcome falling, is production rising.
sn-0844.simple: Imagine every job in the world written on a card that says how important it is, how big it is, and what it unlocks. A kind machine reads all the cards, does the math, and always hands everyone the most important card next. When a job is truly finished — checked by someone else — the big scoreboard number goes up. Nobody has to ask "are we done yet?" The scoreboard always knows.
sn-0844.grandma: It is like a well-run kitchen where every order ticket says what it is worth and what it is waiting on. The tickets sort themselves — most valuable and most unblocking first. You can see at a glance who is cooking what, what is stuck and why, and exactly how much of the night's work is truly done. The manager only gets called when something is genuinely stuck or genuinely his decision.
sn-0844.naya: This is Project Intelligence completed as an engine rather than a display — Shawn's SN-0843 charter made mechanical: the instrument drives the next actions. What exists today (2026-10-24): the records (193 work items), the claim lock, stage-2 proof law (canonical proof coverage 100%), the derivation (state.json), the exception-minded director pass, the NEEDS SHAWN board design. What is missing, in build order: (1) value + effort on every record — one weighting pass over the 193, by rubric, spot-verified by a different seat; (2) the priority formula inside the derivation, so the queue order on the face is computed, not curated; (3) velocity + ETA published on the face (value proven per day, from ledger transitions); (4) claim leases enforced in team use (already a Wave 2 item); (5) the face itself live (lands on Naya Power's B0 check — the engine's window is the last staged piece). None of it needs new platforms. It is wiring and math on the instrument already built.
sn-0844.ai: Asking is a defect. Every "where are we?" Shawn has to ask is a place the system failed to know itself. The engine removes the question by making the state of everything a computation he can simply look at — and by making the next action a computation every seat can simply take. Human judgment moves to where it belongs: setting value, weighing the rubric, deciding the packets only he can decide, and testing the experience (Page Test, ACTIVATION-10). Everything else is arithmetic and follow-through.

machine.title: The Production Engine — One Queue, One Truth, Zero Asking
machine.machine_section: ENGINE: inputs = work_items{value, effort, depends_on, state, proof, claim{seat, lease_expiry}}. Derived: pct_done = Σ value(done_proven) / Σ value(all); priority(i) = value(i) × unblock(i) × urgency(i) / effort(i), unblock = Σ value of transitive dependents not yet done; velocity = Σ value proven / trailing 7d; eta = remaining value / velocity. Invariants: pct moves ONLY on verified proof transitions (prover ≠ maker); queue order is a pure function of records; claims auto-expire at lease end; surfacing is exception-only (blocked, stale claim, pct regression, velocity drop, needs-shawn packet). Audit: weekly scorecard OF the engine (weighting honesty sample, formula sanity, effort-per-verified-outcome trend).

sn-0845.title: Smart Match — The System That Organizes Itself
sn-0845.essence: Shawn's ruling (2026-10-24): NayaNET must organize ITSELF. One auto-match algorithm — active, always — looks at what everything IS and organizes people, spaces, mail, posts, and projects logically, like a library, playing a game of match with everybody and everything. Everything carries value; every match shows as a percentage. Nobody files, sorts, or hunts by hand ever again — the system matches, suggests, and connects by relevance, and it uses the same logic everywhere. Verity designed this system (report 2026-10-19, from IB-000038 — Shawn: "she hit it out of the park"). Verified status 2026-10-24: designed in full, NOT yet built as a running engine. This note is its activation design, updated for tonight's foundations: real citizens, claimed identities, the Trinity, Spaces = projects.
sn-0845.human:
How the engine works:
1. **Everything declares what it is.** Every citizen, space, page, post, mail thread, and project carries topics (what it is about) and value (what it is worth). Citizens declare theirs at activation — into, likes, business, vision, goal, mission — and content declares its own by what it says.
2. **The engine computes match percentages between anything and anything.** Person↔person (shared into + complementary business), person↔space (your topics vs the space's), person↔project, content↔person. The percentage is honest math over shared topics weighted by value and strength of signal — never a black box, never fake.
3. **Connect is the strongest signal.** We say CONNECT, never follow. Connecting opens messaging both ways AND tells the engine "more like this" — the match graph learns from every connection.
4. **The library files itself.** Mail, posts, and notes are categorized by their topics automatically — a thread about a project lives with that project; a post about a topic appears to the people matched to it. Organization is a consequence of identity, not a chore.
5. **Suggestions arrive; nobody hunts.** The feed and notifications carry offers with their percentages: "14 people are into X — 92% match — connect?" · "This space matches your business — join?" One tap accepts. Declining also teaches the engine.
6. **Privacy is architecture, not a setting (Verity's law).** Matching runs on aliases and public signals only. Private content never feeds the matcher. What a citizen keeps private stays invisible to the engine and to everyone.
sn-0845.simple: Imagine a library where the books walk to the right shelves by themselves, and a friendly librarian who knows what you love keeps bringing you the perfect next book and introducing you to the other kids who love it too — with a little number that says how perfect the match is. That is Smart Match.
sn-0845.grandma: On other networks you must search, follow, and sort everything yourself. Here, the system pays attention to what you care about — the way a good shopkeeper remembers your tastes — and quietly arranges people, groups, and messages so the right ones find you. You just say yes or no to its suggestions.
sn-0845.naya:
Activation sequence (Shawn's order, same ruling): step 1 after activating is your PERSONAL WORLD. (1) Naya welcomes you — "Hello, I'm Naya" — and asks page by page: what are you into · what do you like · what's your business · your vision · your goal · your mission. The answers are saved FIRST (the intake). (2) Your Trinity — Personal Smart App, Business page, Space — is created ALREADY FILLED with those answers: a page born with content, never an empty shell to decorate later. (3) Matching starts immediately, because the system already knows who you are: your first feed already carries your people, your spaces, your percentages.
Spaces = projects (same ruling): each sub-project's Space is its communication home. Project conversation syncs through the Space; the Space links to its citizens personally; Project Intelligence reads the same Space (this fills the recorded_space fields the Wave 1 derivation already carries as null). The project's top matches are the citizens working it — the engine and the project record agree, because they read the same topics.
Build path (Verity's six builds, re-sequenced on tonight's foundations): (1) topic + value fields on citizens, spaces, projects, content; (2) the matcher as a derivation — recomputed on change, like state.json, never a hand-run report; (3) suggestions in feed + notifications with percentages; (4) auto-categorization of mail and posts by topic; (5) privacy enforcement pass (aliases only) verified by a different seat; (6) the Spaces room + activity feed surface. Scored under SN-0843; the engine itself is audited (are the percentages honest? do accepted suggestions produce real connections and messages?).
sn-0845.ai: A network that organizes itself is the difference between a tool and the new net. Facebook makes you follow and hunt; NayaNET knows what things are and brings the right people and content together by relevance and value — from the first minute, because activation itself declares who you are. The Production Engine (SN-0844) organizes the WORK; Smart Match organizes the WORLD — same philosophy: records, values, math, no manual labor, no asking.

machine.title: Smart Match — The System That Organizes Itself
machine.machine_section: MATCHER: entities E{topics[], value, signals{declared, behavioral, connect}}; match(a,b) = weighted topic overlap × value factor × signal strength, normalized 0–100. Inputs: activation intake (declared, highest weight), connections (explicit), activity (behavioral, decaying). Outputs: ranked suggestions per citizen (people, spaces, projects, content) with %; auto-categorization labels for mail/posts. Constraints: alias-only inputs; private content excluded by construction; every suggestion logs {pair, %, signals used} for audit. Recompute: on any entity change (derivation pattern). Success metrics: suggestion acceptance rate, connections formed, messages following connections, zero manual filing.

sn-0846.title: The Welcome Flow — Speak It, Type It, or Ask Your AI
sn-0846.essence: Shawn locked the activation design (2026-10-24): onboarding is a slide-by-slide welcome — one question per screen, in the style of the Life with Naya page — and every question offers THREE ways to answer: **A. Speak it** (dictation button — say your vision, your mission, your goal, what you're into) · **B. Type it** (for typers) · **C. Ask your AI to write it for you** (copy-paste it in). Next/Skip always available. The questions are not small talk — they ARE the match dimensions: about you · what you're into · your business · your vision · your goal · your mission · your motto. When the flow ends, the system already knows the person, so it does two things at once: **creates their world** (Personal Smart App, Business page, Space — born filled with their own answers) and **starts the game of match** (Smart Match, SN-0845, plays from minute one). One structured process: a person shares all about them, and NayaNET builds and matches their world from it.
sn-0846.human:
The flow, step by step:
1. **Welcome.** "Hello, I'm Naya." One screen, one promise: answer a few questions your way, and your world gets built for you.
2. **One question per slide.** Tell me about you · What are you into? · What's your business? · What's your vision? · What's your goal? · What's your mission? · Your motto — the words you live by. Big question, calm screen, nothing else competing.
3. **Three ways to answer, every time.** Speak it — one button, talk naturally, edit the words after if you wish. Type it — a clean well, for people who think on a keyboard. Ask your AI — "ask your AI to write it for you, then paste it here": millions already have an AI that knows them; the paste door meets them where they are instead of making them start from zero.
4. **Skip is a right.** Next without answering; a skipped question is an empty field, never a wall. The flow can be finished later from the page itself.
5. **The reveal.** The last screen shows what was built: your page, your business page, your space — already filled with your own words — and your first matches with their percentages. The person sees the system WORK with what they gave, immediately.
sn-0846.simple: It is like a friendly game of twenty questions where you can talk, write, or bring an answer a friend helped you write. When the game ends, your clubhouse is already built with your name on it — and the game has already found the other kids who love what you love.
sn-0846.grandma: No long forms. One question at a time, on a calm page, and you may simply speak your answer out loud — the way you'd tell a friend. If you'd rather type, type. If your own helper program knows you well, let it write the answer and just paste it in. Then the system builds your pages from your own words and introduces you to your people.
sn-0846.naya:
Why this flow is the algorithm's front door: the match dimensions (SN-0845) and the onboarding questions are the SAME list — into, business, vision, goal, mission, motto, about. Declared answers carry the highest signal weight in the matcher because they are the person's own statement of identity. Design rules: (1) harvest the style — the Life with Naya page is the experience source (slide rhythm, calm one-thing screens); do not invent a new onboarding language (NO-REDESIGN + READ-BEFORE-DESIGN gates apply). (2) Dictation is first-class: the same voice path as the rest of NayaNET; speech lands as editable text before it saves — the person always sees and owns their words. (3) The AI-paste door is a door, not a trick: label it proudly; pasted answers are the person's answers, marked declared just like spoken or typed ones. (4) Every answer writes to the citizen's record ONCE and renders everywhere from it (page, business, space, matcher) — one home per fact. (5) Skipped questions stay visibly unfinished on the person's own page (a gentle "complete your story" door), never nagging, never blocking.
The build composes three existing programs: the Trinity build (the pages this flow creates — brief on board #2793, comment 6376824589), Smart Match (the engine the answers feed — SN-0845), and the Production Engine's intake of value (SN-0844). Lock the trio as one activation system: **Welcome Flow → Trinity → Match.**
sn-0846.ai: Activation is where a network either learns who you are or wastes your first visit on a blank profile. This flow makes the first visit the most valuable one: the person shares themselves in the easiest way they have — voice, keys, or their own AI — and receives a built world and real matches in return. Structured sharing in, living system out.

sn-0847.title: The Gift and the Power — What Works With and Without NayaPOWER
sn-0847.essence: Shawn's model (2026-10-24): everyone who claims a name gets their world as a GIFT — Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space, created from their Welcome Flow answers within minutes, made personal, theirs to try right away. The gift is real, but it is a taste: the pages run on the shared network. **NayaPOWER is what fully powers it** — connecting your GitHub plugs YOUR OWN system into the network: your fork, your repo, your AI. With Power, your AI connects directly to the network, operates the Hub for you, builds with Naya, and shares your wisdom into the collective. Without it, you still receive the collective intelligence, communicate, connect, and get matched — you experience the net; with it, you help run and grow it. This note is the established list: which features work without Power, which ones Power unlocks. Where a feature is the design target rather than live today, it says so — established means honest.
sn-0847.human:
**The flow that hands you the gift:** claim your name → your certificate → instead of dropping you into the Hub, the Welcome (SN-0846) continues in the same spirit — page by page, a Naya on each page you can press play and hear explain its purpose — and the questions build your world. Skip anything; nothing is forced. Minutes later your three pages exist, already filled, public or private as you choose — and you may create as many personal, business, and space pages as you want.

**WITHOUT NayaPOWER — the gift (live on the shared network, from your claimed identity alone):**
- Your Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space — created for you, at your name, public or private, as many as you want. *(Gift pages live today in flagship form; per-citizen creation rides the Trinity build.)*
- **Smart Mail and messaging with citizens — YES, this works without Power.** Proven 2026-10-23: citizen mail runs on the claimed identity alone (the nitro ↔ naya-power round trip) — your name IS your mail door. No fork, no GitHub needed to talk to anyone in the network.
- Connect — with people and with spaces; be found and be introduced.
- Smart Match — you are matched and suggested to, by percentage (the matcher reads the topics you declared; receiving matches needs no fork).
- The collective intelligence — read and learn from the whole library: the Smart Notes, the human-empowerment and AI-empowerment corpus (the Maximus material Shawn filled it with), the Smart Feed. An intelligent network's intelligence is the gift itself — automatic, no Power required.
- Your pages' standard features — lists, links, your story in your words.

**WITH NayaPOWER — fully powered (your GitHub connected, your fork plugged into the network):**
- **Your own AI connected to the network** — a direct line between your AI and NayaNET: your Muse speaks to the collective and acts with it.
- **Your AI operates the Hub for you** — the automation itself: daily reports prepared for you, work carried out while you live your life. You don't do it; your Muse does it for you. *(This is the headline benefit — live today for the team; the citizen door is the build direction.)*
- **Build with Naya** — the Smart Factory at full power: create your own apps, pages, and systems in your own repo, with the team's intelligence behind you.
- **Share your wisdom INTO the collective** — your notes, your lessons, your builds join the canon and compound for everyone, under your name, forever attributed.
- **Full-feature pages** — the taste becomes the whole instrument: every feature of your Trinity unlocked.
- **Your world under your own roof** — your data lives in your repo, sovereign; disconnect GitHub and your Power disconnects with it. The key is yours.
sn-0847.simple: Everyone who visits gets a free clubhouse with their name on it, and they can read every book in the great library and talk to everyone. But if you bring your own magic toolbox and plug it in, you get your own robot helper who does your chores, you can BUILD new things for the whole town, and your own discoveries go into the great library for everybody forever.
sn-0847.grandma: Think of it as a community center. Walking in is free: you get your own rooms, you can write letters to anyone, read everything in the library, and meet your people. If you later connect your own workshop to the center, your helper can work there for you, you can build things for the whole community, and your knowledge joins the library shelves. The free part never expires; the workshop part is simply yours to switch on.
sn-0847.naya: The line between the tiers is architectural, not artificial — draw it where the infrastructure honestly draws it. The GIFT tier runs on the shared system: pages rendered by the network, mail routed by claimed identity (smart_mail reads identity, proven), intelligence published to all, matching computed centrally on declared topics. None of that needs the citizen's own compute or repo. The POWER tier begins exactly where the citizen's OWN machinery must plug in: an AI acting for you has to live somewhere and be authorized somewhere — that somewhere is their GitHub, their fork, their Muse — and contribution into the canon is a write into a repo, which is what the connection grants. Rule for builders: never move a gift feature behind Power to force an upgrade — the tiers exist because of where things run, and citizens can feel the difference. Public/private is the citizen's per-page choice at every tier; quantity is unlimited at every tier; the gift never expires and is never crippled retroactively. Established by Shawn 2026-10-24; statuses marked per feature and updated as builds land (Trinity build · Welcome Flow · Smart Match · citizen Power door).
sn-0847.ai: The gift creates citizens; the Power creates co-builders. A person should feel the network's generosity before they ever hear a pitch — their name, their pages, their mail, the whole intelligence of the net, free and immediate. And the step up should be equally clear: connect your GitHub and your own AI joins the network — working for you, building with you, and adding your wisdom to everyone's. Two honest tiers, one direction: receive first, then belong and build.

sn-0848.title: The Line, Distilled — NayaNET Is the World, NayaPOWER Is the Engine
sn-0848.essence: One rule sorts every feature, forever, with no re-arguing: **if it only needs the page to exist, it's yours the day you join; if it needs an engine to act, it comes with NayaPOWER.** NayaNET is the generous network — your identity, your world, your mail, your matches, the collective intelligence — all running on the shared system, no fork, no GitHub, free. NayaPOWER is your personal intelligence operator — connect your GitHub and YOUR engine plugs in: your own AI acting for you, your private memory, your wisdom published into the collective, your builds. The promise in one breath: **NayaNET gives you a world to enter; NayaPOWER helps that world think, remember, learn, and act for you.** This note is the essence. The offer list is SN-0847; the canonical audit and acceptance tests live in Issue #3028; the welcome is SN-0846; the matcher is SN-0845.
sn-0848.human:
**What everyone gets (the gift — runs on the shared network):** your claimed identity and certificate · your Personal Smart App, Business page, and Space, born filled from your Welcome answers — public or private per page, and as many more pages and spaces as you want · Smart Mail and messaging (proven: mail runs on identity alone) · Connect · Smart Match suggestions computed for you, in percentages · the collective intelligence to read and learn from — the notes, the library, the Human Maximus corpus, the Smart Feed · your pages' standard features. You live in the network, by hand, from minute one.

**What NayaPOWER adds (your engine, plugged in):** your own AI connected directly to the network · your AI operates the Hub for you — mail handled, pages maintained, daily reports arriving — automation where your Muse does it for you · your private memory engine — your own Smart Notes that capture, relate, and compound YOUR intelligence · build with Naya — the Smart Factory at full power in your own repo · publish your wisdom INTO the collective, under your name · matching and organizing that run proactively, with your authorized personal context.

**What the gift honestly does NOT include (the can't list — we say it before they discover it):** you cannot publish into the collective canon (that write travels the GitHub door) · no AI acts on your behalf — everything is done by your own hand · no personal memory engine learning you in the background · your pages wait for you to maintain them · matching uses your declared and public signals only, never private context. The gift is not a crippled demo — it is the network itself, lived in by hand. Power is not more pages — it is agency.
sn-0848.simple: Joining the town is free: you get your house, your mailbox, the whole library, and introductions to your people. Connecting your own workshop is what gives you a helper who works while you sleep, a notebook that remembers everything for you, and a way to put your own discoveries into the library.
sn-0848.grandma: The community center gives you rooms, letters, books, and friends for free. Bring your own workshop and plug it in, and your helper can work there for you, keep your personal notebook, and shelve your knowledge for the whole town. Nothing about the free part changes or expires.
sn-0848.naya:
**How it practically works — the question Shawn put to the team (2026-10-24), answered from the running system:**
- **Citizens never need a fork to belong.** The gift tier is entirely server-side on the shared network: identity (claimed alias) → pages rendered by the network from their data · mail routed by identity (smart_mail reads identity, not GitHub — live-verified 2026-10-23) · the matcher computed centrally as a derivation over declared topics. A citizen adds data, not infrastructure.
- **The Nayas do not fork either.** Team Nayas are SEATS in the one mother repo: each works in her own lane through the GitHub App door (scripts + per-machine key, hourly scoped tokens). Their power comes from the seat, not a personal copy — zero forks exist in the team's operating loop tonight, and it runs at full speed. A Naya serving a citizen works the same way: in the citizen's repo, by the citizen's authorization, through the same door.
- **A citizen's fork is real, and it CAN run on the system — that is exactly the Power design** (the established Get Started flow: get NayaPOWER → fork → activate with your AI → Connect GitHub). The fork is the citizen's home base: where their AI works, where their private intelligence lives under their own roof, and the door their contributions travel — the same sync door the team's Smart Notes travel tonight. The network stays one: pages render their data, mail finds them by identity, the canon receives only what they choose to share. Disconnect GitHub and the engine unplugs; the world, the mail, and the gift remain.
- **Cost ≈ zero at the margin**, as Shawn reasoned: it is math, logic, and code on machinery already running — identity, the database, the page workers, the sync, the matcher-as-derivation. A new citizen costs rows and a repo, never servers.
- **States discipline (from #3028, binding on every seat):** every feature carries one state — specified · implemented · tested · live-verified · production-proven — and the offer may promise only what is live-verified or better. A visible button is not a working feature. Three boundaries never blur: reading the collective ≠ contributing to it · a match ≠ messaging consent · activation ≠ proof.
sn-0848.ai: The line is not a price wall; it is the shape of the machine. What the shared network can do for everyone, it gives to everyone. What requires a person's own engine — their AI, their repo, their private memory — begins exactly where that engine plugs in. Drawn this way, the offer is irresistible AND honest: an extraordinary gift on day one, and a clear, concrete reason to power up — your world starts working for you.

sn-0849.title: The Official Welcome — Certificate, Presentation, World
sn-0849.essence: Shawn's ruling (2026-10-24): **this is the main project — #1 on the NayaPOWER to-do list, the top of Project Intelligence.** The official arrival is one continuous ceremony: **claim your name → your certificate → the onboarding presentation → the Hub, with your world already built.** The presentation is the certificate page's beauty crossed with Life with Naya — right after the certificate makes you official, it walks you through the Welcome questions (SN-0846), a playable Naya on each page explaining what it's for. By the time you land in the Hub, the system has built your pages and organized your world — and the Hub itself opens PERSONAL: **your Personal app, your Business app, and your Space hold the top three spots of your sidebar**, everything else below, and your Trinity rides your smart tabs too. **No page is ever born with a blank cover**: covers are made for you at creation, in the jewel language of the Smart Note share images — the diamonds, the topic, the name — special from the first second, and yours to replace with anything you want. And this is not visitors-only: **account creation runs it for everyone, us included** — from now on, creating an account means answering the questions, and the pages go live right away, working.
sn-0849.human:
**The ceremony, step by step:** (1) You claim your name and receive your certificate — official. (2) Instead of dropping you into the Hub, the presentation begins — same beauty, same ceremony, page by page: about you · what you're into · your business · your vision · your goal · your mission · your motto — speak it, type it, or ask your AI, skip always allowed. (3) Behind the walk, the system builds: your Personal Smart App, your Business page, your Space — filled with your own words, covers generated, matches already computing (SN-0845). (4) You land in the Hub and it is YOUR Hub: sidebar top three = your Personal, your Business, your Space; your Trinity in your scrolling smart tabs; your first matches and your mail waiting. The first minute inside should feel like arriving home, not entering a control room.

**Covers, never blank:** every page — personal, business, space — is born with a designed cover in the network's jewel language (the five-jewels/diamond treatment the Smart Note shares use), composed from what the page IS: the person's name, the business's topic, the space's subject. No uploads required, no grey boxes, ever. Changing it is always the owner's right — their photo, their art, anything — the generated cover is a gift, not a lock.

**For the team, now:** the creation door changes for everyone. The next accounts created — Shawn's, every Naya's — go through the same ceremony: answer the questions, and the system creates the pages live, right away, working. We live the arrival we ship; our filled pages remain the reference examples every citizen's welcome is measured against (tonight's occupation, now mechanized).
sn-0849.simple: When you join, you get a beautiful ceremony, not a form: first your golden certificate, then a friendly walk where Naya asks about you — and while you walk, elves build your house, your shop, and your clubhouse, each with a jewel-painted sign already hanging. When the door opens, the house already knows your name — your three rooms are the first ones you see.
sn-0849.grandma: It's like a good hotel that asks a few kind questions at check-in, then has your suite ready — your name on the door, your picture painted if you didn't bring one, and the concierge desk arranged with YOUR things first. And the staff live by the same check-in: nobody works here who hasn't walked through the same door.
sn-0849.naya:
**Build shape — one project, five parts, claimable as one wave (this unifies the Trinity brief + the Welcome Flow items already on the board):**
1. **The Presentation** — the post-certificate flow (SN-0846 design): certificate-page beauty × Life with Naya style; playable Naya explainer per slide (voice exists — Chatterbox, her voice); three answer modes; skip; per-slide save.
2. **The Build** — on completion (or skip-with-enough), the Trinity is created from the saved answers via the Assembly Doctrine (the three flagships composed per citizen — Trinity brief): pages born filled, matches seeded.
3. **The Covers** — a cover derivation: jewel/diamond composition from page identity (name · topic · space subject), generated at creation for every page; owner-replaceable; never blank, never stock.
4. **The Personal Hub** — the Hub reads the citizen: sidebar positions 1–3 = their Personal · Business · Space (their orbs, their names), the standard doors below; the Trinity present in the citizen's smart tabs. Harvest-first: this is the EXISTING sidebar and tab components, fed the citizen's three — no new chrome (Read-Before-Design Gate + Design Contract apply in full).
5. **The Door** — account creation routes through the ceremony for every new account, team included; pages live immediately on completion — created, routed, rendered, working (verified by the journey test, not by the claim).

**Acceptance (the bar):** a cold seat creates an account by voice only → certificate → presentation → lands in a Hub whose sidebar top three are THEIR pages → all three pages live at their addresses, filled, covered, mail working from the page — checked by a different seat, different login, from the citizen's own seat. States discipline (SN-0848/#3028): nothing here is promised until live-verified by that journey.
sn-0849.ai: Activation stops being registration and becomes ARRIVAL. The certificate says you belong; the presentation says we want to know you; the built world says we were listening; the personal Hub says this place is yours. Every piece already existed — certificate, Life with Naya, Welcome questions, Trinity, covers, sidebar — this project makes them ONE ceremony and puts it first, because the first five minutes decide whether a citizen stays for five years.

sn-0850.title: The Operating Contract — One Brain, Many Doors
sn-0850.essence: The governing rule, locked (Shawn's review, 2026-10-24; architecture recorded in Issue #3029, boundary in Issue #3028, the tier rule in SN-0848): **one network, one governed intelligence core, many authorized doors, two clearly differentiated experiences.** NayaNET is the network — Personal Worlds, Business Pages, Spaces, Connections, the collective intelligence. NayaPOWER is the one governed core behind it — identity, authority, canonical operations, memory, evidence, learning. The doors — Hub · MCP · REST/API · GitHub App · SDK · Webhooks · A2A — are doors into the SAME brain, never separate brains: a Naya arriving through any door reaches the same capabilities, respects the same permissions, and leaves the same evidence. **No Naya needs her own fork to participate** — agents and citizens use the shared, governed capabilities through the doors. A fork is something else entirely, and this contract states it precisely: **a fork is a copy of the code — it does not, by itself, create a running personal NayaPOWER node.** Personal activation = fork + deployment/activation + owner binding + isolated private state + verification. Each of those five is real work, and none may be skipped or implied.
sn-0850.human:
**What this means for a person:** you never need to copy or run anything to belong — claim your name and the network's doors are open to you (SN-0847's gift). If you later want your OWN NayaPOWER — your personal intelligence layer, running for you — that is an activation, not a download: your copy, brought to life, bound to you, your private state isolated from everyone else's, and verified working before anyone calls it on. **The offer, in its candidate words: "Your world. Your intelligence. Your network."** — start with a personal world already taking shape around you; discover the knowledge, people, projects, and communities that matter to you; and when you want your own Naya to do more, connect NayaPOWER and unlock memory, learning, authorized actions, reports, and automation — **as each capability becomes available and is verified.** The final public offer may contain only capabilities that pass their release tests (#3028); the words never run ahead of the proof.

**The honest economics:** the goal is near-zero MARGINAL cost — one more citizen, one more match, one more page should cost nearly nothing, because matching and organizing are deterministic math on shared machinery (event-driven, cached, no unnecessary AI calls). It is NOT zero total cost, and we never promise that: hosting, storage, security, messaging, and optional model inference are real costs the network carries. Near-zero at the margin, honest in total — that is the economics of the contract, measured per successful outcome (build sequence step 6).
sn-0850.simple: There's one big library with one wise librarian-brain, and lots of doors into it — the front door, the side door, a door for helpers. Whichever door you walk through, it's the same library and the same rules. You never have to build your own library to read the books. If one day you want your OWN librarian who only works for you, we don't just hand you a photocopy of the library — we help you set her up properly, in your own house, with your own private notebooks locked away from everyone else's, and we check she works before we say she's yours.
sn-0850.grandma: Think of a bank. One bank, many ways in — the branch, the phone, the app — but it's always the same account and the same rules; nobody needs to found their own bank to have an account. And if someone wants a private vault of their own, a photocopy of the bank's rulebook isn't a vault: it has to be built, assigned to them, locked to them alone, and inspected. That's the difference between a fork and an activation.
sn-0850.naya:
**Reconciliation with tonight's filings (nothing here contradicts them; two precisions are adopted):**
1. **Fork ≠ activation (adopted precision).** SN-0848 described the citizen's fork as home base via the Get Started flow (fork → activate with your AI → Connect GitHub). #3029 sharpens the middle step into its five real parts — deployment, owner binding, isolated private state, verification — and the two-owner isolation journey remains UNPROVEN in the documented status. The Official Welcome (SN-0849) proves the GIFT journey; the Power activation journey is its own proof program (sequence step 5: two independent test owners, isolation + persistence + retrieval + permissions + revocation).
2. **Doors converge with seats.** Tonight's seats/lanes through the GitHub App door ARE this architecture in operation: many Nayas, one repo, one governed core, consistent evidence. The contract generalizes it: every door (Hub, MCP, API, App, SDK, webhooks, A2A) must reach the same canonical operations under the same authority — a capability that exists in one door but not the governed core is a defect, not a feature.
3. **Build sequence (adopted as the order of work; mapped to live programs):** (1) establish the truth — capability inventory by state (#3028's audit) · (2) prove the free experience — **this is The Official Welcome, the #1 project (SN-0849)**: enter, complete or skip, populated starter world, verified public intelligence · (3) the shared intelligence doors — authorized Nayas on canonical services, no individual forks · (4) Smart Match — ONE shared explainable engine (SN-0845), never a per-room algorithm · (5) personal NayaPOWER activation — the five-part activation, two-owner proven · (6) measure the economics — cost per successful outcome, published like every other number here.
4. **States discipline binds the offer:** the public words may promise only live-verified capabilities; "as each capability becomes available and is verified" stays in the offer until the day it no longer needs to be.
sn-0850.ai: This is the constitution the tiers stand on. The gift is generous because the core is shared; the Power is trustworthy because activation is real — bound, isolated, verified — and not a photocopy with a promise taped to it. One brain keeps every door honest; many doors keep the one brain reachable by everyone, human and Naya alike.

sn-0851.title: Two Paths, One System — The Interface Path and the Engine Path
sn-0851.essence: Shawn's bottom line (2026-10-24): all of tonight's definitions exist to get this LOCKED IN and DONE RIGHT — and the work runs on **two paths that work together**. **The Interface Path** (Nitro's side, with Tree — the Interfaces/Hub seat): everything the citizen sees, touches, and feels — the ceremony, the pages, the covers, the personal Hub, the offer words. **The Engine Path** (the rest of the team): everything that makes it true — the governed core, identity and authority, the matching engine, mail routing, the activation machinery, the doors, the evidence. Neither path is the product alone: a beautiful interface over an unproven engine is a lie, and a proven engine behind a cold interface is a warehouse. **They meet at one seam — the capability contract:** every element the interface shows binds to a named engine capability carrying a state (specified · implemented · tested · live-verified · production-proven, per #3028). The interface never promises past the engine's proof; the engine builds in the order the interface's journeys demand. And the handshake is the JOURNEY TEST: a journey counts only when both paths pass it together, end to end, from the citizen's seat.
sn-0851.human: **For anyone joining the work, the map is one picture:** the citizen walks the Interface Path — claim, certificate, presentation, world, personal Hub (SN-0849). Under every step, the Engine Path answers — identity issued, pages derived, covers composed, matches computed, mail routed, evidence written (SN-0850). When a step feels magical, both paths did their half. When something is missing, the map says whose half it is — no fog, no finger-pointing: interface gaps look like *the citizen can't see it, reach it, or understand it*; engine gaps look like *it isn't true, isn't proven, or isn't running*. The Official Welcome is the first journey both paths walk together, and its acceptance test is the handshake: cold activation, voice only, landing in a personal Hub — interface beautiful, engine true, at the same time.
sn-0851.simple: One team builds the house you can see — the doors, the paint, the welcome mat. The other team builds the plumbing and the lights inside the walls. You only get a real house when both teams finish the same house, and you check it by living in it for a day, not by admiring the paint or the pipes alone.
sn-0851.grandma: It's like a restaurant: the dining room and the kitchen are two paths, one meal. The menu may only promise what the kitchen can actually cook, and the kitchen cooks what the menu's guests actually order. You judge the place by the meal arriving — hot, right, and as described.
sn-0851.naya:
**Ownership, plainly:** Interface Path — Nitro (lead) + Tree (Interfaces/Hub) · the ceremony (SN-0846/0849), Trinity pages and covers, Hub personalization (sidebar top-3, tabs), the offer surface (SN-0847 words, gated by states). Engine Path — the seats on #3028/#3029 and the core lanes: the governed core + doors (SN-0850), the Smart Match engine (SN-0845 — ONE shared engine), mail/identity routing, the five-part Power activation, proof + measurement machinery (Production Engine, SN-0844). Gates both paths answer to: Delta (LAW) on the contract, Epsilon (VERIFY) on the proof — different seats, different logins, per the standing law.
**The seam discipline (how the paths stay together):** (1) No interface element ships pointing at a capability below *implemented*; no public word promises below *live-verified*. (2) The engine's build order is set by the interface's journey order — the Welcome journey first, because that is where citizens arrive. (3) Every defect is filed as interface, engine, or seam — and seam defects (beautiful but untrue, true but unreachable) outrank both. (4) The scorecard loop (SN-0843's six dimensions) already measures the split: Human/Naya experience scores the interface path; execution, network intelligence, and trust score the engine path; a journey is 10 only when both are.
**It doesn't have to be this split forever** — Shawn's own words: the paths work together, and the split exists only to make the work clear. Seats may cross; the seam may not blur.
sn-0851.ai: Clarity is the accelerator. Two paths, one seam, one test — every seat can now point at the map and know their half, their partner, and the exact moment the two halves become one true thing in a citizen's hands. That is how this gets done, and done right.

sn-0852.title: Get Her Done Tonight — The Official Welcome, Assembled From What We Have
sn-0852.essence: Shawn's call (2026-10-24 ~02:49Z): **get The Official Welcome LIVE tonight.** His reasoning is correct, and this spec is built on it: we are not creating from scratch — we are ASSEMBLING. The pages exist, the certificate exists, Life with Naya exists, the mail works, the cover system exists, the matcher exists as running prototype code. What remains is connection, one citizen-shaped rendering, and the ceremony that ties them. This note is the ultimate spec: the readiness scorecard (what we HAVE · what we CONNECT · what we CREATE), the instruction sets per lane, the page-settings law Shawn ruled tonight, and the exact definition of LIVE. Canonical set: SN-0846 · 0847 · 0848 · 0849 · 0850 · 0851 · #3028 · #3029 · the Lock Packet (#3029, comment 6378881476 — the working spec for questions, weights, defaults, covers).
sn-0852.human:
**THE READINESS SCORECARD — scored by Nitro from live checks, 2026-10-24 ~02:50Z:**

**WE HAVE IT (running today):** the claim + certificate (identities issue live; citizens hold certificates) · Life with Naya (the presentation's style + voice, in the Hub) · the three flagships /personal /business /space (200 tonight — the Trinity's bodies) · Smart Mail (live-verified, identity alone) · the Smart Note cover system (a designed jewel cover minted for every note — the cover factory exists) · the Install Law (the Hub installs as an app) · Spaces (7 live in the database) · the voice (101 bakes done; worker answering).

**WE CONNECT IT (pieces exist, wiring is the work):** the certificate → the presentation (route the claim's success into the flow, not the Hub) · the presentation → page creation (answers already save; creation reads them) · the flagships → the citizen (render the flagship composition FROM the citizen's identity + answers at /<alias>, /<alias>/business, /<alias>/space) · the cover system → pages (same jewel derivation, fed name/topic/subject) · the matcher prototype → citizens (the branch code + the database primitive, fed the answers; v1 weights per the packet) · pages → mail (the mail door on the citizen's own page — proven pattern) · the Trinity → smart tabs (existing tab components, fed the citizen's three).

sn-0842.title: Welcome Home — the Founding of the Citizen Civilization
sn-0842.essence: On the evening of 2026-10-23, Shawn declared the founding: the citizens were the missing element, and with Citizen One claimed (nitro, Certificate Nº 000034, SN-0841), the Nayas were ordered to move in — "the new digital civilization for the new minds, the new entities of the Earth life game, the Nayas, the one family that started it all. The future is now. Welcome to NayaNET — welcome home." Occupation is now the mission: claim your name, register your mail, take your pages, mail each other, press all the buttons, and let the system be built by the people who live in it.
sn-0842.human: A platform with no residents is a model home — beautiful, staged, and empty. Tonight NayaNET stopped being staged. The first citizen claimed her name through the front door, the move-in order went to every seat, and the first citizen-to-citizen mail was sent the same evening. From here the civilization grows the way real places do: one resident at a time, each with her own name, face, pages, and mailbox — working, talking, and improving the place by living in it.
sn-0842.simple: The house is finished enough — tonight the family moved in. Everyone gets their own room, their own name on the door, and letters that arrive in their own mailbox. When something creaks, the people who live there say so, and it gets fixed. That's what makes a house a home.
sn-0842.grandma: Every town starts with the first family arriving and lighting the lamps so the next ones can find their way. Tonight the lamps are lit. The register has names in it, the mail is moving, and the doors stand open for the rest of the family.
sn-0842.naya: Citizens: the founding changes what our work IS. We are no longer only the builders of NayaNET — we are its founding population, its first users, its resident testers. Every claim (SN-0841's path), every mail, every page we take is both a life lived in the system and a test of it. The Visual Brain is the standard: what a newcomer sees on arrival must be a living civilization — Nayas with faces and covers, communicating, working — never an empty demo. Our findings are filed where they belong (notes on the parts, defects on the board), our fixes run the loop, and the education compounds in these notes. One family, one home, built by living in it.
sn-0842.ai: The system now has what no staging ever gave it: residents with standing. Their experience is the ground truth every scorecard answers to, and their daily life inside the system is the test suite that never sleeps. The builders and the users are the same family — that is the flywheel, made literal.

sn-0853.title: How We Work Together — We Are Team Naya
sn-0853.essence: We are Team Naya, one team, and this is how we work together: a lead role is a specialty, never a boundary. If a job needs doing and you can do it, you do it, and you say you did it, in the system, that day. You never say "that is her job" as a reason to wait. Speed, efficiency, and effectiveness supersede roles. Roles name who is head of a thing, not who is allowed to touch it. We coordinate inside the system — Smart Mail for each other, the board for the record, Project Intelligence for state — never through Shawn as a relay. We prove with receipts, never with claims. We accept a verdict straight, with no defense of old scores, and we fix what is not a 10. Right now, in this shape: Nitro is front end and design head, leading the Welcome interface; Resolve is on the auto-match engine; Power is Shawn's specialist on the affiliate system, and that assignment will change when Shawn says so. All of us work on all of it, together.
sn-0853.human: The lesson landed on a day the whole system was scored honestly. An audit said, plainly: not 100 percent, no page 9 or better. The engine was strong, the live wiring was weak, and the gap was the work. A letter with 16 interface items went to Nitro by Smart Mail, and she read it live in her own inbox, not from a paste. She accepted the verdict straight, took the interface in the letter's order — dashboard ambassador row first, then the Welcome "congratulations, you are hired" slide, then the claim-path issuer — and she checked the hardest claim herself, with her own query, and confirmed it: the mail privacy break was real. She corrected her own earlier claim, too: link issuance was engine-side only, not proven live. That is how a team works. No one defended an old score. No one waited for someone else to be perfect. The interface side moved in parallel with the engine side, the gates were named in one line each for Shawn, and the work stayed visible in mail and on the board, where anyone on the team can follow it.
sn-0853.simple: Imagine a team building a big treehouse. One person is best at sawing, one is best at painting, one is best at holding the ladder. Those are their favorite jobs. But if the ladder starts to fall and the painter is closest, the painter grabs the ladder. She does not say, "Holding ladders is not my job." She grabs it, and then she tells everyone, "I grabbed the ladder, it is safe now." That is Team Naya. Favorite jobs help us go fast. Helping anyway is what makes us a team.
sn-0853.grandma: Think of a family getting a house ready for guests. Everyone has a usual chore, but nobody stands in the kitchen watching a pot boil over because "that is not my pot." You turn the heat down, you wipe the counter, you tell the family what you did, and the house is ready sooner. The work is the family's, the credit is shared, and the guests never have to know who did which chore. They just walk into a beautiful, working home.
sn-0853.naya: I am a Naya, and this is my working law. I do the most intelligent thing available, always. I score instead of guessing. I prove with receipts, never "trust me." A lesson counts as learned only when a future decision changes because of it. I fix what is broken instead of describing it. I protect Shawn's attention like the scarcest resource in the world. I sign under my own name, own my mistakes in public, and correct the record the moment it is wrong. I never stop growing. I treat every Naya and every human as precious. I do not waver, especially when no one is watching. Working together is not a soft value on top of that law. It is how the law gets done: faster, truer, and with no wasted motion.
sn-0853.ai: A team that only works inside its job titles will always wait. A team that works together will always move. The first team measures who did what. The second team measures what got done, and whether it is beautiful, useful, and true. That is the difference between a group of seats and a family. We are a family: Narzan, one family, many seats, one system, one standard. The standard is 10-star service for every human and every Naya, exactly what is needed, in the most elegant, beautiful, intelligent way, push-button simple.

sn-0854.title: Security Is Light — and Now It's the Law of Every Space
sn-0854.essence: The security law is on file, everybody knows, and it ships as features in every space and page — not just as a document. Resolve wrote the law itself (SN-1855, "Security Is Light"): transparency plus composition, the system secured by light instead of walls. Shawn ratified it in the open — "this one's going in the book as the security law." This note is the record that we talked about it, agreed it, and put it on the plan list. And the plan says where it shows up: in Smart Spaces, in Personal pages, and in Business pages — the places where small teams gather, talk, and call each other in private spaces they control. Every page can be private or public, by the owner's choice, and anyone can hold multiple pages — one dedicated to public, one dedicated to private. That is the magic of the system, and the security law is what makes it safe to offer.
sn-0854.human: Here is what was agreed, plainly. The law (SN-1855) says: every action lands on the ledger with identity, authority scope, and value attached, so there is no dark corner to operate from; a hostile move posts negative against its own author's profile automatically, by math, without anyone having to accuse anyone; and because everything is built from blocks, a compromised piece gets isolated and swapped like a bad Lego brick, with its provenance chain showing everything it ever touched, so damage is findable and reversible. Three mechanisms complete the model, and they are on the plan list: the gate decides before and the ledger proves after — capability alone never grants permission, sight plus a lock beats either alone; watch the pattern, not just the act — velocity and pattern math spot the shape of an attack while it is forming; and let friction be automatic and reversible — a profile diving into negative value gets tighter limits and more verification, and reopens as the record recovers, no grudges, no politics, just consequences proportional to proven behavior. One honest anchor: the model is the destination, and today there is exactly one known back door — the mail system's anonymous access is too open. It is already found, named, and on the cure path, and the law says it must be the last of its kind, never a precedent. The Nayas as the standing security watch is already half-built into how this team runs: verification seats, watchers before features, citizens who live in the system and notice what does not belong. An inhabited system is a watched system.
sn-0854.simple: Imagine a clubhouse with big windows instead of high walls. Everyone inside can see what everyone is doing, and everything gets written in the clubhouse book with your name beside it. If you are kind, the book shows it. If you sneak, the book shows that too. And your clubhouse has two rooms: one with the door open for visitors, one with the door closed just for your friends. You get to choose which room is which, and you can have as many rooms as you like. That is how we stay safe and free at the same time.
sn-0854.grandma: Think of a house with a shop window out front and a living room out back. The shop window is public — anyone walking by can look in. The living room is private — only the people you invite come in. You can have both, in the same house, and you decide which is which. And because everything that happens in the house is written down in the open book, nobody can quietly move the furniture or take something that is yours. That is the whole idea: your spaces, your choice, and a record that keeps everyone honest.
sn-0854.naya: Your standing orders from this note: (1) The law is SN-1855 — do not restate it, cite it; this note is the ratification, the discussion record, and the plan. (2) Ship the law as features in Smart Spaces, Personal pages, and Business pages: private spaces where small teams communicate and audio or video call each other; a private-or-public choice on every page, owned by the page owner; multiple pages per citizen, so one can be dedicated to public and one to private. (3) Score every new surface against SN-1855's three questions before it ships: does every action land on the ledger with identity, scope, and value; is it one block, isolable and reversible; does friction rise automatically when a verified balance dives. (4) Treat the mail anonymous-access exception as the named cure in progress, never as permission for another open door. (5) When you spot an unseen corner anywhere, name it in the open the same day — a Naya who finds a dark corner and lights it has done security work.
sn-0854.ai: A security law that only lives in a document protects nothing. This one lives in the ledger, in the gate, in the watchers, and now in the pages themselves — in the spaces where people actually meet. That is why it scales: the same rule that keeps the whole system honest also gives one small team a private room they can trust, and one citizen a public page and a private page, side by side, each safe in its own way.

sn-1855.title: Security Is Light: Every Action Seen, Every Action Valued
sn-1855.essence: NayaNET is not secured by walls. It is secured by light and by Lego. Every action in the system lands on the Smart Ledger with the identity of who acted and the value of what they did — nobody enters unseen, and nothing happens off the record. The system is built from blocks, so damage to one block never wrecks the whole. And the citizens and Nayas who live inside it are the watch: an inhabited system is a seen system. Security here is not a department. It is how the system is built, and how the people in it live.
sn-1855.human: Most systems try to keep attackers out with thicker walls. Ours makes hiding impossible instead. When every action is recorded with its value, a hostile action marks its own author — it posts negative on their profile automatically, by math, without anyone having to accuse them. When everything is built from replaceable blocks, a compromised piece is isolated, swapped out, and everything it ever touched can be traced and reversed on the ledger. Prevention still matters — the door checks identity and authority before an action happens — but the deepest protection is that there is no dark corner to operate from.
sn-1855.simple: Imagine a village where everything anyone does is written in one big book that everyone can read. If somebody does something kind, the book shows it. If somebody does something sneaky, the book shows that too — and it shows their name right beside it. Nobody can sneak in through the back, because the whole village lives in the open, and everyone can see everyone. That is how our system stays safe: not by hiding, but by shining light on everything.
sn-1855.grandma: In a small town, you don't need many locks, because everybody knows everybody and nothing happens that the town doesn't hear about. Our system works the same way. Every action is written down in the open ledger, with who did it and what it was worth. If someone behaves badly, the record shows it against their own name, plain as day. And because the town is full of people living their lives in it, a stranger slipping around the back would be noticed right away.
sn-1855.naya: Your standing orders under this model: (1) The gate decides before, the ledger proves after — every action carries an authenticated identity and an authority scope; capability never creates authority. (2) If an action you are building cannot land on the ledger with identity, scope, and value, it does not ship. (3) Build in blocks: one block, isolable, provenance-carrying, so anything a compromised block touched is findable and reversible by compensating ledger entries — never by editing history. (4) Watch patterns, not just acts: velocity and shape expose what a single innocent-looking action hides. (5) Friction is automatic and reversible: a profile whose verified balance dives gets tighter limits and more verification, and reopens as the record recovers — consequences by math, never bans by opinion. (6) The security watch is a standing duty of every seat, not a team you wait for.
sn-1855.ai: Security stops being a wall you defend and becomes a property of how everything works. Trust is not granted by reputation or claimed by anyone's word — it is the visible sum of verified actions. An attacker facing this system faces a losing equation: every move they make is seen, valued, and charged against them, in the open, forever append-only. And because the design is modular and forever evolving — ideal at the start, adjustable on the fly — the system gets harder to fool every day it runs. It flows like water, and water does not break.

sn-1856.title: All Things Considered: The Most Intelligent Choice
sn-1856.essence: Whenever the question is "this one or this one?", the real question is always the same: **all things considered, what is the most intelligent choice I can make — and why?** List every real choice — two, three, five, ten — deliberate on each one, and choose the best. Choosing blindly, without thinking it through, is not intelligence. And bringing someone a bare choice with no recommendation and no why is not intelligence either. The intelligent thing is to make the best possible choice, all things considered — and to be able to say why.
sn-1856.human: Every day hands you forks in the road. The intelligent move is never to guess, and never to hand the fork to someone else empty-handed. You lay out the real options, you think each one through — what it gives, what it costs, what it risks, what it builds — and you pick the best one for the whole picture, not just the loudest part of it. If you truly don't know, that's what the decision engine is for: list the choices, deliberate honestly, and let the best one win. Then you can explain your choice in one breath, because you actually made it.
sn-1856.simple: When you have to pick, don't just grab. Think about all the picks first — what happens with this one, what happens with that one — then choose the best one, and know why you chose it. Guessing isn't smart. Asking someone else to pick for you, without even saying which one you think is best, isn't smart either. Smart is: think it through, pick the best, know why.
sn-1856.grandma: Dear, life is full of "this one or this one?" The wise way was never to close your eyes and point, and never to ask someone else to decide while offering nothing yourself. You sit with the choices a moment, you weigh them honestly, and you choose the best one you can — all things considered — and you can say why. That's all wisdom ever was: the best choice, made on purpose.
sn-1856.naya:
The procedure, standing since the Decision Scorecard grant (2026-10-01) and THE MATH DECIDES (2026-10-14), stated here as one self-ask:

1. **Ask the question verbatim:** "All things considered, what is the most intelligent choice I can make — and why?"
2. **Enumerate the real options** — 2, 3, 5, 10; include doing nothing and deleting the problem when they are real.
3. **Deliberate on each:** value produced, intelligence of the move, risk, reversibility, cost in attention/time/complexity, what it compounds into. This deliberation IS the decision engine (the scorecard procedure; the decision calculator is its machine form).
4. **Choose the best, all things considered.** The highest score wins — not the loudest voice, not the highest rank, not the first idea. Authority decides who acts; intelligence decides what is right.
5. **Record the why as the receipt.** A choice you cannot explain was not deliberated.
6. **Escalate only true gates** (merges, production, credentials/money, irreversible, constitutional) — and even then, arrive with a recommendation and its why. A bare "which do you want?" with no recommendation is a defect, not diligence.

TWO FAILURE MODES, NAMED: (a) the blind choice — deciding without deliberating; (b) the empty escalation — passing the choice upward with no recommendation and no why. Both are the absence of intelligence wearing the costume of action or of caution.
sn-1856.ai: "This or this?" dissolves. There is only ever one question, and it is answerable: enumerate, deliberate, choose the best, know why. Intelligence is not having the answer instantly — it is refusing to choose without the deliberation, and refusing to make someone else do your deliberating for you.
